title: Hypoxia-Associated Glycolytic-Lipogenic Reprogramming and Impaired Antigen Presentation in SPP1Tumor-Associated Macrophages in Ovarian Cancer.
snippet: Ovarian cancer has an immunosuppressive microenvironment in which SPP1tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) are linked to poor prognosis and immune evasion, yet their molecular features and metabolic mechanisms remain unclear.
